content:
Alex: Quick sync — we need a short PRD + RFC for the Optimize recommendations feature (batching/caching/quant profiles). Customers keep asking for concrete configs they can apply or autoclose. Can we scope an MVP?

Priya: +1. Core product asks: clear acceptance criteria, measurable launch metrics, and a rollback plan. Proposed metrics: p95 latency regression <=10%, token cost reduction >=20% for batch inference workloads, and no >2% drop on our QA evals.

Mateo: Edge cases to consider: single-request low-latency flows, streaming responses, function-calling with tool invocations, and KV cache invalidation. Quantization can break logits for some decoders — need guardrails.

Jing: Acceptance criteria + verification steps: automated eval harness runs (unit tests + eval suites), perf bench on representative traces, canary rollout (10% traffic), and telemetry spikes monitored (error rate, perplexity drift). Docs + SDK examples required.

Sam: Curious about priority vs infra tickets (dedicated autoscaler work). Is this a 2-sprint project or bigger?

Alex: MVP scope suggestion — generator that outputs a small JSON recommendation package: {
  "batch_hint": 8-32,
  "max_target_p95_ms": 200,
  "quant_profile": "int8_dynamic" | "fp16",
  "cache_policy": "prefix_cache_v1",
  "apply_mode": "suggestion"
} — surfaced in Console as a suggestion. No auto-apply initially.

Priya: Launch checklist: RFC approved, PRD with acceptance criteria, 5 benched customer workloads, docs + example SDK flows, canary + rollback playbook, support training for SEs.

Mateo: Implementation notes: need a profiling job to sample sequence length distribution and memory footprints, new table in infra to store per-customer recommendations, and a fast estimator to predict latency/cost for candidate configs. Also add safety toggles for models that fail quant tests.

Jing: Proposal for experiments: pick 3 hosted customers (batch-heavy), 2 internal workloads (streaming + function-call), run offline sweep of batch x quant x cache combos, rank by cost saving vs latency impact, pick top 2 per workload for canary.

Sam: OK. If this needs infra slots, we should deprioritize non-urgent autoscaler improvements. Otherwise we risk contending for GPUs.

PlanBot: New RFC issue created: #optimize-recs-1791. Owners: Alex, Jing. Due: 7d.

Alex: Decision: proceed with RFC + lightweight PRD. Owners: Alex (product lead), Jing (experiments + bench), Mateo (implementation + infra). Deadline for RFC draft: one week. If anyone has major objections speak up now. :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup: will add acceptance criteria to the PRD template and start a small eval matrix doc.

Mateo: Noted — I’ll sketch the profiling job and DB schema tomorrow and ping @eng-infra.

Jing: I’ll draft the experiment plan and sample set. Putting a quick config prototype here for review:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-13b-fp16",
  "recommended": {
    "batch_size": 16,
    "quant": "int8_dynamic",
    "cache": {"type": "prefix", "ttl_s": 300},
    "expected_cost_reduction_pct": 29,
    "expected_p95_increase_pct": 6
  },
  "notes": "avoid int8 for long-context decoding >2k tokens"
}
```

Alex: Great. I'll open the PRD doc and link to the RFC. Target sync next Wed after RFC draft. Thanks all.
